metrics.profile_summary: Growth-focused digital marketing leader with over 10 years of experience specializing in SEO, PPC, and customer acquisition. Proven track record in scaling global SaaS and e-commerce brands through data-driven strategies and team leadership.

experience.description: Led a 5-member team for PureVPN, managing global SEO, PPC, and content strategies. Optimized conversion funnels and conducted A/B testing to drive global sales growth.
Managed B2B SEO for NetSuite and Salesforce, executing keyword research, website audits, and performance reporting.
Directed on-page/off-page SEO and social media initiatives for various brands, while training and mentoring junior executives.

strengths: Deep expertise in GA4 and ad platform reporting
Proven people management experience (led teams at Gaditek and Right Solution)
Strong track record of ROI/ROAS achievements
Local to Karachi with relevant MBA degree
weaknesses: Experience is heavily weighted toward digital execution rather than holistic brand/budget ownership
evaluation.summary: The candidate is an exceptional match, exceeding the years of experience and technical requirements. He possesses the necessary leadership background and local presence to effectively own the marketing function.
